definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
This Fair Wage Policy ensures that all workers receive compensation that meets or exceeds legal requirements, industry standards, and, where applicable, living wage benchmarks.

Choksi Heraeus Pvt. Ltd. is committed to paying all employees a Fair wage that reflects the regional cost of living and ensures coverage of essential needs such as food, housing, healthcare, and education.

Our wage structure is designed to be regularly reviewed and adjusted based on local economic factors and inflation trends.

Conduct annual assessments to ensure wages reflect local living costs and employee well-being.

The FY 2022-23 serves as the baseline for all fair wage-related targets at Choksi Heraeus. This includes commitments to wage equity, living wage alignment, and wage transparency across all employee categories. Progress will be measured against this baseline to ensure continuous improvement and alignment with evolving standards and targets set to achieved by FY 2028-29.

The review will evaluate the relevance of the policy in light of: Local inflation and living costs; Industry wage benchmarks; Internal wage equity and employee feedback

Annual Wage Review and Equity: Ensure equitable wage distribution across departments, considering factors such as performance, gender, and background.
Conduct annual assessments to ensure wages reflect local living costs and employee well-being.
Employee Satisfaction on Fair Wages: Cultivate a workplace where employees feel their compensation is fair and reflective of their contribution.
Ensure that 100% of wage revision communications are transparently shared with employees.
Performance-Based Wage Increases: Implement a transparent, merit-driven wage increase system linked to individual performance and skill enhancement.
